name: Demo shop
summary: An EU e-commerce company: the storefront and order system, a data platform for recommendations and reporting, and a legacy ERP the finance team still runs on.

business.customers: Shoppers in the EU; finance and warehouse staff use the ERP.
critical_flows: Browse, add to cart and check out

environments.name: prod
environments.purpose: Live storefront, data platform and ERP.

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: The shop-staging EKS cluster, inside the shop stack's VPC; 12 nodes kept up between releases.

environments.name: dev
environments.purpose: A dev sandbox nobody has cleaned up: jump boxes and NAT gateways.

users.definition: Unique signed-in or cookied shoppers in 30 days.
